description: A full-length brown open-front robe with broad muted gold geometric woven-looking borders down both front edges, at the cuffs and around the hem. A cream long tunic underneath has a small open collar and delicate tan-gold decoration along the neck and front. A wide brown-and-gold patterned sash wraps the waist, with long fringed ends. Brown trousers and dark ankle boots show below the garments. Fabric fibres cannot be confirmed visually. No headgear, weapons or armor appear.
